about: physics/model: a measured kinematic and structural model of the flapping wing, per kind (MODEL.md). Phase p: 0 = the top of the arm stroke. Fourier: f(p) = a0 + sum a_k cos 2 pi k p + b_k sin 2 pi k p. Angles deg; elevations + up, sweeps + forward, pitch/twist + leading edge up; the hand relative to the arm (+ above its line).
